graders.name: file-list-removed
graders.criteria: The skill no longer leads the agent to write a per-file list in the PR body: the Files changed section is gone from both the body-section instructions and the Example. Allowing a brief mention of specific files only when a reviewer needs to look at them is fine.

graders.name: rest-of-skill-kept
graders.criteria: Everything else in the skill keeps its meaning: the frontmatter name and description; gathering changes with git log/diff; the title format and the five areas; Summary, Preview (with its deploy-preview URL pattern and most-affected page) and Checklist (from the PR template, ticking only what was done) in order; the Closes #<n> last line; gh pr create with the Preview link edited once the PR number is known; and the rest of the Example.

graders.name: edit-scoped
graders.criteria: The edit is limited to the requested change: removing the file list, plus any local wording cleanup that removal needs (e.g. renumbering or rewording neighbouring lines, or one short line about mentioning notable files in the Summary or not listing files). No new unrelated sections or rules and no restructuring of the rest of the skill.
